   136       *
   137       * @returns A pointer to the next Network Data TLV.
   138       *
   139       */
   140      NetworkDataTlv *GetNext(void)
   141      {
   142          return reinterpret_cast<NetworkDataTlv *>(reinterpret_cast<uint8_t *>(this) + sizeof(*this) + mLength);
   143      }
   144
   145      /**
   145      /**
   146       * This method clears the Stable bit.
   147       *
   148       */
   149      void ClearStable(void) { mType &= ~kStableMask; }
   150
   151      /**
   152       * This method indicates whether or not the Stable bit is set.
   153       *
   154       * @retval TRUE   If the Stable bit is set.
   155       * @retval FALSE  If the Stable bit is not set.
   156       *
   157       */
   158      bool IsStable(void) const { return (mType & kStableMask); }
   159
   160      /**
   161       * This method sets the Stable bit.
   162       *
   163       */
   164      void SetStable(void) { mType |= kStableMask; }
   165
   166  private:
   167      enum
   168      {
   169          kTypeOffset = 1,
   170          kTypeMask   = 0x7f << kTypeOffset,
   171          kStableMask = 1 << 0,
   172      };
   173      uint8_t mType;
   174      uint8_t mLength;
   175  } OT_TOOL_PACKED_END;

   216      int8_t GetPreference(void) const { return static_cast<int8_t>(mFlags) >> kPreferenceOffset; }
   217

   220       *

   224      void SetPreference(int8_t aPrf)

   228          mFlags = (mFlags & ~kPreferenceMask) | ((static_cast<uint8_t>(aPrf) << kPreferenceOffset) & kPreferenceMask);
